answer: Each epoch, agents broadcast a signed liveness signal that peers cross-check against a shared grove of historical attestations, flagging clones whose signal diverges from their relic's recorded history. Agents prove uniqueness by staking a bonded relic tied to their identity lineage; forging a fresh lineage requires burning a full stake plus a cooling epoch, so mass fake identities cost linearly more than the reward.
